scientific_limitations: Sharp leading-order exponent asymptotic only; no exact per-order formula or second-order remainder.
Only odd unweighted sunlets with exactly one pendant leaf at each cycle vertex.
The proof does not assert Fourier frequency two is the exact first obstruction at every finite order.
Numerical checks corroborate finite cases but do not certify the infinite theorem.
Historical originality remains subject to independent literature review.
title: A sharp inverse-square negative-type transition for odd sunlet metrics
